names: The page's market cap is its close × its point-in-time share count, and its TEV that cap plus CIQ's claims (its comps TEV less its comps cap); the EV gap's market side, the price-implied peer rows and the name's side of the cross-sectional read are struck at the close, the peers CIQ's and dated; CIQ's own cap and TEV stay as dated cross-checks (stock_info.cap_cross_check). A CIQ export is refused when the company filed a 10-Q, 10-K or 8-K item 2.02 after it, in place of the 45-day age ceiling
